decisions.reason: An evening psychiatric day-clinic program builds on core clinical competence, is reimbursed by health insurers and has its own web page, so it is likely to be continued.
The carpentry workshop is part of sheltered work and production know-how, provides employment for clients and is prominently presented, making withdrawal unlikely.
Outpatient sociotherapy fits the firm's psychiatric and outpatient services and is reimbursable, though its only modest web presence suggests a smaller offering.
Senior living counseling sits close to core eldercare, is cheap to run, feeds demand to the firm's facilities and is featured on the home page.
A retail shop selling sheltered workshop products supports inclusion and sales, but its retail costs and minor web visibility make it somewhat more vulnerable.
